content: Native PDF viewer compatibility: Chrome/Edge/Firefox desktop render application/pdf inline in object/embed/iframe; Safari desktop in iframe reliably, object unreliable; iOS Safari only renders PDF inline in iframe (object/embed not supported) and shows fallback otherwise - always provide a download link. #toolbar=0 fragment respected by Chrome viewer mainly for same-origin iframe/tab; unreliable cross-origin and ignored by Safari - do not depend on it. Blocked-by-XFO cross-origin PDF cannot be detected via iframe load/error events (load always fires) - MDN.
